title: Agent Identity RP attestation claims (agent-rp-attestation+jwt)
description: Contract G claims for the Broker-B-signed RP attestation published in the optional `rp_attestation` discovery field. PRODUCER MODE: every object is closed (`additionalProperties: false`); a v1.2 producer MUST NOT emit unknown fields. A verifier MUST validate every known field and ignore unknown additive fields it does not understand; the verifier gate is `parseRpAttestationVerifier` in `@agentregistrar/discovery`, not this closed schema. The JWS header is {alg: EdDSA, typ: agent-rp-attestation+jwt, kid}. Cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express (exp-iat = 86400, rp.id = sub, legal_name at `entity`, entity_reviewed_at null at `domain`, unique keys[].kid) are normative in agent-identity-v1.md and enforced by Zod and the validator. Normative definition: agent-identity-v1.md §14.

iss.description: Broker B issuer origin: lowercase, no path, query, or fragment. MUST equal the `issuer` of its broker metadata.

aud.description: Protocol label, never the human broker issuer.

jti.description: Attestation id: `rpa_` + 26-character lowercase Crockford base32 ULID (no i/l/o/u). Unique per issuance.

exp.description: Expiry, integer seconds. exp - iat MUST equal exactly 86400.

origin.description: Canonical origin of the discovery document that carries this attestation. MUST equal the fetched document origin, never provider_url or terms.url.

legal_name.description: Legal entity name. OPTIONAL at `domain`, REQUIRED at `entity`.

level.description: Assurance level. No `enhanced` in v1.2; neither level asserts safety.

method.description: The method that verified control of the origin.

entity_reviewed_at.description: null at `domain`; non-null at `entity`. Records when the operator reviewed the entity; no ordering requirement against origin_verified_at.

keys.description: Every active key plus every retiring key whose retire_after is in the future (1-8 entries, unique kid). Public material only.

purposes.description: Exactly ["receipt","abuse"] in v1.2. The array is retained so a future split is additive; a v1.2 producer MUST NOT emit a subset.
